<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="ecc_agent_script_file"><ecc_agent_script_file action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><checksum/><description>Get JSON with Proxmox QEMU VMs' config</description><directory>false</directory><name>Proxmox_VMs_config.sh</name><parent display_value="SSHScriptFiles">48deb961ff123100ab8fffffffffff07</parent><script>#!/bin/bash

# 1. Get name of local node
local_node=$(sudo pvesh get /cluster/status --output-format json \
  | tr ',' '\n' \
  | grep -A 3 '"local":1' \
  | grep '"name"' \
  | head -n1 \
  | sed -E 's/.*"name":"([^"]+)".*/\1/')

# 2. Get list of VMs from local node
vmids=$(sudo pvesh get /nodes/"$local_node"/qemu/ --output-format json \
  | tr ',' '\n' \
  | grep '"vmid"' \
  | sed -E 's/.*"vmid":([0-9]+).*/\1/')

# 3. Get configs and create JSON array
echo "["

first=1
for vmid in $vmids; do
    cfg=$(sudo pvesh get /nodes/"$local_node"/qemu/"$vmid"/config --output-format json)

    # --- counts ---
    disks=$(echo "$cfg" \
      | tr ',' '\n' \
      | grep -E '"(ide|scsi|virtio|sata)[0-9]+|efidisk0"' \
      | wc -l)

    nics=$(echo "$cfg" \
      | tr ',' '\n' \
      | grep -E '"net[0-9]+"' \
      | wc -l)

    # inject counts before closing brace
    cfg_with_counts=$(echo "$cfg" | sed -E "s/}$/,\"disks\":$disks,\"nics\":$nics}/")

    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then
        first=0
    else
        echo ","
    fi

    echo "$cfg_with_counts"
done

echo "]"
</script><script_attachment/><source/><sys_class_name>ecc_agent_script_file</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>karel.benes</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-18 12:27:08</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d9332607c3f97650982a7d0ed40131ed</sys_id><sys_mod_count>12</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Proxmox_VMs_config.sh</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>ecc_agent_script_file_d9332607c3f97650982a7d0ed40131ed</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>karel.benes</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-19 20:18:25</sys_updated_on><use_attachment>false</use_attachment><version/></ecc_agent_script_file></record_update>
